subject: Rerun Westside homepage with grounded Penpot agent
body: EXECUTE NOW. Build the minimum real editable Westside Watch homepage board in the currently connected Penpot file. Create one real 1440x1200 Board named '02 — Westside Watch Homepage v0.1 — API Grounded', Living Paper #FAF9F5 background, editable WESTSIDE WATCH masthead in Ink #252525, one First Light Gold #A2872A 1px rule, one large editorial hero/title block, and one 5:8 visual rectangle. Use only the official Penpot Plugin API grounding already injected by the agent. Return exact board id, then export that exact board as PNG. Do not create probes, swatches, placeholders, or tiny diagnostic rectangles. Stop on exact tool error rather than guessing API.
design_brief: Contemporary editorial Westside Watch homepage. Quiet, intelligent, spacious, architectural. Canonical colors: Living Paper #FAF9F5, Ink #252525, First Light Gold #A2872A, Watch Night #102A43. This run is a minimum construction and export acceptance test before expanding the page.
